chrome_hint: eBay.com.au sold listings: 'aluminium extension ladder 8m', 'aluminium extension ladder 9m', 'Bailey extension ladder 2 section'; Gumtree/Facebook Marketplace Tasmania 'extension ladder aluminium' for local asking; Grays/Lloyds/Pickles sold 'aluminium extension ladder'; also new retail ASKING on Bunnings and Bailey/Gorilla sites for a comparable 7.3-9m two-section (new retail price entry).
viewing_check: Look for a brand/maker plate or rating label (Bailey, Gorilla, Indalex, Zarges), the extended length stamped on the stile, duty rating (150 kg industrial vs 120 kg), bent rungs or stiles, working rope/pulley and locking dogs. Note: very long ladders are awkward to transport and resell locally; a short measured length would lower value.
